_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution: the mutation vocabulary belongs to ONE subset of ONE standard of ONE artifact, so its (non-)oracle registration and catalog live here rather than in a shared manifest. `s.stdio.semio.presentation` is a semio-NATIVE format — no third party reads or writes `.dsl.semio`/`.pack.semio` for it, so no oracle is registered (see noOracleDecisions below).

noOracleDecisions.rationale: No third party reads or writes semio's own `.dsl.semio`/`.pack.semio` envelope, and none is authoritative over this subset's `SemioPresentationMutation` vocabulary — fifteen verbs over an INDEX-addressed slide and shape tree and two id-keyed master/layout collections. `python-pptx` was surveyed as the obvious candidate, because this subset is deliberately modelled on pptx (`p:sld`/`p:sldMaster`/`p:sldLayout`/`p:spTree`/`a:tbl`/`p:ph`), the cross-language oracle hosts have landed (a Python venv is provisioned and version-checked per declared package; `extract-text-pdf-1-4` executes its `pypdf` scenarios today), and a real `.pptx` fixture is committed in this repository. It was rejected on three findings. First, reaching a `SemioPresentationSnapshot` from pptx bytes requires THIS repository's own `🚪️io/📥️import`/`📤️export` pptx bridge, so a differential would run our importer against our exporter with a third party merely re-reading the result — the self-comparison this platform exists to prevent. Second, `python-pptx` cannot create slide masters or slide layouts at all, so `insert-master`, `insert-layout`, `remove-master`, `remove-layout` and `set-layout-master` — a third of the vocabulary — have no reference counterpart. Third, `set-snapshot`'s semantics are `SemioPresentationDiff::between`, a whole-state structural comparison that no presentation library models. Confidence instead comes from specification vectors whose BEFORE state is the real committed example artifact `🏅️standards/🔖️v1/🪆️subsets/✳️any/📚️examples/📽️deck/🖼️assets/🗣️example.dsl.semio` (asserted byte-identical to `demo_semio_presentation_snapshot()`, so the fixture can never silently drift into a synthetic one), plus the inverse law as a metamorphic property: applying a mutation and then its own computed inverse must restore the exact pre-mutation state, including slide and shape ORDER, which is what an index-addressed vocabulary makes load-bearing.
